name: physical_storage_and_recall_after_restart
description: Rebuild each treatment table from its manifested workload, measure the bytes reachable from Iceberg metadata, and re-read every requested observation after restarting the persistent catalog.

protocol.execution: serial, one operator, no concurrent treatment run
protocol.rebuild: DROP TABLE ... PURGE for every treatment table, then run the treatment apply scripts in the order B0 B1 B2 B3

footprint.definition: bytes of every object reachable from the table metadata of retained snapshots
footprint.size_source: MinIO object listing of the table location
footprint.unreferenced_objects: reported separately and never counted as footprint
footprint.physical_rows: sum of record_count over reachable data files

recall_after_restart.restart: docker compose restart iceberg-rest after the last repetition

access.B1: observation_id in any retained snapshot read with VERSION AS OF

invariants: the catalog is persistent before any measurement starts
every repetition reproduces the recorded treatment verification markers
every metadata-referenced object exists in MinIO with the size recorded in metadata
unreferenced objects in a table location are not counted as footprint
all repetitions are reported; aggregation happens only after row-level checks
after a catalog restart B1 and B3 recall all 38 observations and B0 and B2 recall 14
no runtime is measured or claimed
